run_process_answers_cli: run the CLI to extract VQA answer vocabulary from train and val annotation JSON files
run_filter_answers: run filter_answers on a VQA annotations dataset to get answers above a minimum occurrence threshold
run_get_score: run get_score to compute a VQA answer scoring value from 0 to 1 based on occurrence count
run_multiple_replace: run multiple_replace to replace multiple substrings in text using a dictionary of replacements
review_filter_answers: review the filter_answers function that preprocesses VQA answers using EvalAIAnswerProcessor and filters by frequency
